paths.title: AI for Engineers
paths.tagline: Faster reports, reviews, and communication - with codes, calculations, and stamped judgment always left to you.
paths.description: A ladder of 6 hands-on lessons for engineers using Claude, ChatGPT, and Perplexity: turning field notes into structured technical report drafts, explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, building reusable review checklists for documents and drawings, researching codes and standards with citations, drafting meeting minutes and RFI/change-order communications, and building reusable documentation templates for your discipline. Every lesson treats AI output as a non-final draft or research aid - never a substitute for engineering judgment, code compliance review, or stamped calculations.

paths.title: AI for Architects
paths.tagline: Faster proposals, narratives, and client communication - with design judgment and code compliance always yours to verify.
paths.description: A ladder of 6 hands-on lessons for architects using Claude, ChatGPT, and AI image tools: turning meeting notes into project proposals and fee letters, writing concept narratives that sell a design, exploring visual concepts with AI image tools, drafting client-facing project documentation and updates, drafting planning and consent documents with compliance guardrails, and writing portfolio and case-study copy for practice marketing. Every lesson treats AI output as a non-final draft or illustrative aid - never a substitute for design judgment, zoning and code compliance, or the architect's own stamped work.
